items.name: ARRI Alexa 35
items.description:
Arri's compact Alexa 35 features a 4.6K Super 35-format sensor capable of capturing 17 stops of dynamic range. With an exposure index adjustable from 160 to 6400, the camera incorporates four built-in motorized ND filters (clear, 0.6, 1.2, and 1.8) and offers a maximum frame rate of 120 fps.

Includes:
● ARRI MVF-2 Viewfinder
● ARRI B-Mount Power Distribution Module (PDM-1)
● ARRI PL-to-LPL Mount Adapter
● Codex Compact Drive 1TB / 2TB
● Codex Compact Drive Reader
● Full Licensing (ARRIRAW, ProRes, Open Gate, 4:3, Anamorphic)

items.name: Sony Venice 2 8K
items.description:
Building on the original Venice, Venice 2 features a compact design, internal recording, and an 8.6K full-frame CMOS sensor that can capture 16 stops of dynamic range. The camera also offers a dual-base ISO of 800/3200 and 8 stops of built-in ND filters. The Panavision Modular accessory system adds further functionality.

Includes:
● Sony VENICE Accessory Cage / Top Plate Kit
● Sony OLED Viewfinder
● Power Distribution Module
● Lens Mount Adapter options
● Codex Compact Drives / AXS-R7
● Full Licensing (Full Frame, 8.6K, Anamorphic, SLog)

items.name: ARRI Alexa Mini LF
items.description:
The Alexa Mini LF combines the Alexa Mini's compact form factor with the Alexa LF's large-format sensor. Exclusively from Panavision, the Mini LF can be rented with the Panavision Modular accessory system and a Panavised lens mount.

Includes:
● ARRI Advanced Accessory Cage
● ARRI MVF-2
● BEBOB Power Splitting Box
● ARRI PL-LPL Mount Adapter
● Codex Compact Drives
● ARRI Codex SXR Capture Drive Dock
● Full Licensing (4:3, ARRIRAW)

items.name: ARRI Alexa Mini
items.description:
The compact and lightweight Alexa Mini can be fitted with a Panavision lens mount for compatibility with Panavision optics, and its versatility can be further enhanced with the custom Panavision Modular accessory system.

Includes:
● ARRI MVF-1
● CFast 2.0 Cards
● CFast 2.0 Reader (USB-A, USB-C)
● Full Licensing (4:3, ARRIRAW)

items.name: ARRI Amira
items.description:
Arri's Amira offers an ergonomic design that's well-suited to handheld, shoulder-mount operation. As with the Alexa cameras, the Amira can be Panavised with a Panavision lens mount and Panavision Modular accessories.

Includes:
● ARRI MVF-1
● CFast 2.0 Cards
● CFast 2.0 Reader
● Servo Lens Interface
● Full Licensing (4:3, ARRIRAW)

items.name: Panasonic VariCam LT
items.description:
The VariCam LT packages the VariCam 35's 4K Super 35mm sensor in a lightweight, single-body design. Both the VariCam 35 and the VariCam LT can be fully outfitted with Panavision Modular accessories, including custom-engineered baseplates, top plates, handles, side rods, and more.

Includes:
● ARRI MVF-1
● CFast 2.0 Cards
● CFast 2.0 Reader
● Servo Lens Interface
● Full Licensing

items.name: Sony PXW-FX9
items.description:
The Sony FX9 packages Sony's 6K full-frame Exmor R sensor into a compact, lightweight, single-body cinema camera designed for both documentary and narrative production.

Includes:
● SONY XDCA-FX9 Extension Unit
● Sony XQD G Series Cards
● Sony XQD Card Reader
● PL-E Mount Adapter
● EF-E Metabones Adapter

items.name: Sony FX3
items.description:
Inspired by Sony's high-end cinema cameras, the FX3 is a compact full-frame camera that delivers stunning 4K footage with 15 stops of dynamic range. It features dual base ISO (800/12,800) for excellent low-light performance and a built-in cooling system for extended shoots.

Includes:
● SONY NP-FZ100 Batteries
● SONY CFexpress Type-A Cards
● SONY Card Reader
● XLR-K3M Audio Handle
● EF-E Metabones Adapter

items.name: Sony F55
items.description:
The Super 35-format Sony F55 captures 16-bit image files at up to 4K raw. Enhancing the user experience, Panavision has developed and manufactured the custom-designed Panavision Modular accessory package.

Includes:
● ARRI Cage for Sony F5/F55 VCT-U14
● Sony AXS-R5 Recorder
● Sony Pro+ SxS Cards
● Sony AXS S24 / SxS Cards
● Sony AXS Card Reader
● Servo Lens Interface

items.name: DSMC2 Monstro 8K
items.description:
The RED Monstro 8K VV sensor can capture up to 60 fps when recording full format. The sensor is housed in a DSMC2 camera body, which can be further enhanced with Panavision Modular accessories and a Panavised lens mount.

Includes:
● RED PRO TOUCH 7.0
● RED Mini Mags
● RED Mini Mags Card Reader
● RED EVF
